name: Brandish the Gorgon's Gaze

source.title: Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea

text: You Raise your Mirrored Aegis, though it seems to lose some of its usual luster in favor of the dull sheen of stone. If you Shield Block a melee attack with the mirrored aegis before the beginning of your next turn, the gorgon's eyes upon it flash at the triggering creature, who must attempt a Fortitude save save against your class DC. On a failure, they are Slowed 1 for 1 minute as their body partially petrifies. Regardless of the outcome, that creature is temporarily immune to this effect for 24 hours.
